cost: O(elements + emitted characters), O(elements + text) cell buffering; recursive unparse may repeatedly concatenate subtree strings. No measured speed or general relative numeric-error guarantee for text.
description: Octave-style textual display of values, real/complex common formats and function expression unparse.
forward: Choose real common format from finite extrema/integrality and precision 5 or 16; render column-major cells as rows, split blocks by floor(80/cell_width). Named output adds labels/blank lines; disp omits numeric empty values and prints char rows.
inverse: Numeric zero formatting excludes a printed negative sign; scalar complex imaginary -0 permits minus while matrix complex comparison excludes it. Empty numeric disp excludes a newline, empty char disp includes one.

Printed rounded values admit all floating inputs sharing chosen format and rounding bins; labels do not recover types uniquely. unparse loses closure captures and is not a precedence-repairing inverse parser.
limitations: Partial source-bound model, not semantic proof
Finite synthetic fixtures only; frozen suites/external measurement unexecuted
state: Logical values use nonzero predicate; char values map codepoints. Precision controls significant digits, but exact integer branch remains integer up to 15 digits.
